articles.title: Crypto steadies as Middle East tensions counter U.S. inflation report boost
articles.snippet: Bitcoin held steady at a three-week high as rising tensions between the U.S. and Iran reined in gains from Tuesday's softer-than-expected inflation numbers.

articles.title: Crypto firms face AML risks during post-MiCA migration, says AMLA chair
articles.snippet: AMLA is expanding its crypto oversight as firms complete the transition to the EU’s MiCA licensing regime.

articles.title: US freezes $131M in Iran-linked crypto as Middle East tensions rise
articles.snippet: “US Treasury is committed to disrupting and degrading Iran’s illicit financial activities, including its abuse of digital assets,” US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Tuesday.

articles.title: Bitcoin Ticks Up to $64K Following Largest Inflation Slowdown in Six Years
articles.snippet: Consumer prices cooled more than expected in June, yet geopolitical tensions continue to cast a shadow over crypto prices

articles.title: Bitcoin Treasury Firm Empery Digital Dumps Nearly Half of BTC Holdings for $87 Million
articles.snippet: Nasdaq-listed Empery Digital said it sold 1,400 Bitcoin since May to help fuel an AI data center deal, legal bills, and other expenses.
